title: cirsium makinoi var. shiroumense
intro: Cirsium makinoi var. shiroumense, commonly known as a type of thistle, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, which may be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
